delivery_submissions_review_consistent.name: delivery_submissions_review_consistent
delivery_submissions_review_consistent.value:
("delivery_submissions"."status" = 'pending' and "delivery_submissions"."reviewed_at" is null and "delivery_submissions"."ledger_entry_id" is null)
        or ("delivery_submissions"."status" = 'approved' and "delivery_submissions"."reviewed_at" is not null and "delivery_submissions"."ledger_entry_id" is not null)
        or ("delivery_submissions"."status" = 'rejected' and "delivery_submissions"."reviewed_at" is not null and "delivery_submissions"."ledger_entry_id" is null and "delivery_submissions"."review_note" is not null)

ledger_credit_sale_has_customer.name: ledger_credit_sale_has_customer
ledger_credit_sale_has_customer.value: "ledger_entries"."payment_method" is distinct from 'credit' or "ledger_entries"."customer_id" is not null

ledger_customer_payment_has_customer.name: ledger_customer_payment_has_customer
ledger_customer_payment_has_customer.value: "ledger_entries"."kind" <> 'customer_payment' or ("ledger_entries"."customer_id" is not null and "ledger_entries"."payment_method" in ('cash', 'mpesa'))

ledger_supplier_entries_have_supplier.name: ledger_supplier_entries_have_supplier
ledger_supplier_entries_have_supplier.value: "ledger_entries"."kind" not in ('delivery', 'supplier_payment') or "ledger_entries"."supplier_id" is not null
